senses: to have around one, be clothed with
lex:
περί-κειμαι
[in LXX: Ep. Je 24, 58, 4Ma.12:3 * ;]
__1. to lie round about: μύλος, λίθος (RV, were hanged about), Mrk.9:42, Luk.17:2; νεφος μαρτύρων, Heb.12:1.
__2. to have around one, be clothed with: Act.28:20; figuratively, ἀσθένειαν, Heb.5:2.†

strongs.def: to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper (literally or figuratively)
